thread:
elaine: Quick sync  I'm opening a PR to reconcile our Dedicated docs: some examples use snake_case YAML while SDK uses camelCase. I'll add a small mapping table and a one-line converter. PTAL.

noah: Good idea. Can you include both forms side-by-side and a tiny JS snippet that shows the SDK shape? Saves people guessing.

elaine: Adding side-by-side and this YAML -> JS mapping note. Example YAML I'm adding:
```yaml
tenant_id: acme-9000
labels:
  - analytics
  - priority:high
scale_policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 20
  cooldown: 120
isolation:
  mode: committed
  preemption: false
```

elain: (typo) meant elaine — also adding the JS SDK equivalent: 
```js
await client.dedicated.create({
  tenantId: 'acme-9000',
  labels: ['analytics','priority:high'],
  scalePolicy: { minReplicas: 2, maxReplicas: 20, cooldown: 120 },
  isolation: { mode: 'committed', preemption: false }
});
```

tony: Nice. One nit: docs should call out reserved labels that are rejected (e.g., `reserved_pool`) and show validation error example.

elaine: Adding a short validation snippet and an example error payload. Also updating links: the runbook earlier pointed to /old/terraform which is stale. Replaced with /infra/modules/dedicated-capacity.

noah: Can you add a one-line converter script in docs/examples/dedicated/convert_yaml_to_sdk.js? That will be handy.

elaine: Will add it. Minimal version: parse YAML, map snake_case -> camelCase keys, emit JS object. I'll also include a caveat about not treating illustrative SLA numbers as contractual.

docs-bot: PR opened by elaine: PR #1120  "Docs: unify YAML + SDK examples, add converter and validation notes". Reviewers: noah, tony. Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1120 (queued).

tony: Left two inline comments: 1) prefer "workspace" in user-facing headings, 2) small wording to avoid implying guaranteed latency.

elaine: Good catches. Switching headings to use "workspace" while keeping API examples as "tenant". Updated branch and pushed. Will merge after CI + approvals.

noah: LGTM pending CI. Thanks for cleaning this up — should reduce a lot of copy/paste issues.

elaine: Thanks all!
